globalConstraints: No dominant purple. Every design needs a different silhouette, not only a recolor.
Hero and boss remain recognizable in solid-black silhouette: vary head, shoulder, equipment and body proportions.
Bosses are elaborate and impressive, but not all crowned/caped humanoids.
Moderately lively grounded ready poses, full body and gear visible, child-friendly not horrific.
Transparent background; no shadows outside figure, text, badges, logos, labels or grid.
Broad transparent gutters; each figure entirely within its equal cell.
Pixel creatures must not resemble dinosaurs, dragons or reptiles. Career fusion remains astronaut.
